steps.title: Coat 6‑well plates with Matrigel
steps.instruction: Thaw hESC‑qualified Matrigel stock at 4 °C overnight, keep on ice. Dilute on ice with cold DMEM/F12 until evenly dispersed. Add 1 mL of this working solution to each well of a 6‑well plate, spread gently, and incubate 1 h at 37 °C. Keep Matrigel dilution on ice; freeze pipette tips beforehand to avoid clogging.

steps.title: Prepare mTeSR with ROCK inhibitor
steps.instruction: Add 10 µM Y27632 (Rock inhibitor) to mTeSR1 medium, warm at 37 °C for 30 min (time depends on volume).

steps.title: Thaw and plate H9/H9‑EGFP cells
steps.instruction: Remove cryovial from liquid nitrogen, thaw quickly in a 37 °C water bath until a small ice pellet remains. Dropwise add 1 mL warm mTeSR (with Y27632) to the tube, transfer cells to a 15 mL conical tube containing 3 mL fresh mTeSR per cryovial, centrifuge 200 × g for 2 min. Aspirate supernatant, resuspend cells in 2–3 mL fresh mTeSR + 10 µM Y27632 (use a 1,000 µL tip, pipette 2–3 times gently). Aspirate Matrigel from the coated well and add the cell suspension (2–3 mL per well).

steps.title: Maintain hESC cultures
steps.instruction: On the following day, add 2 mL fresh mTeSR containing 4 ng/mL bFGF to each well. Replace medium daily (or every other day if few dead cells). Monitor colony morphology (high nucleus/cytoplasm ratio, flat well‑defined edges).

steps.title: Passage hESC colonies with ReLeSR
steps.instruction: Prepare a new Matrigel‑coated plate. Aspirate medium, wash once with 1× DPBS. Add 1 mL ReLeSR per well, incubate 30 s, aspirate quickly, then incubate plate 3 min at 37 °C. Add warm mTeSR along the well wall, tap gently to detach colonies, break into small clumps with a 1,000 µL tip. Seed clumps at ~1:10 split ratio into the new coated well, tilt plate horizontally and vertically to spread evenly. Change medium daily until 80–90 % confluence.

steps.title: Prepare all culture media
steps.instruction: Make the following media fresh on the day of use, adding small molecules and growth factors immediately before use:

substeps.instruction: Aggregation medium: 50 mL mTeSR1 + 50 µL Y27632 (10 µM final).
Mesoderm induction medium: 10 mL APEL2 + 12 µL CHIR99021 (6 µM final).
Endothelial induction medium: 20 mL APEL2 + 20 µL VEGF (50 ng/mL) + 10 µL BMP4 (25 ng/mL) + 4 µL bFGF (10 ng/mL).
Endothelial maturation medium: 50 mL MV2 + 50 µL VEGF (50 ng/mL).

Expansion medium: 500 mL DMEM/F12 + 500 mL Neurobasal + 5 mL N2 + 10 mL B27‑no‑VitA + 3.5 µL β‑mercaptoethanol + 250 µL Insulin + 10 mL Glutamax + 5 mL MEM‑NEAA + 10 mL Antibiotic‑Antimycotic; add VEGF 20 ng/mL immediately before use.
Maturation medium: same as Expansion medium but use B27 (with vitamin A) instead of B27‑no‑VitA; add VEGF 20 ng/mL immediately before use.
Ectoderm induction medium: 400 mL DMEM/F12 + 100 mL KSR + 3.5 µL β‑mercaptoethanol + 5 mL Glutamax + 5 mL MEM‑NEAA + Dorsomorphine 2.5 µM + A83‑01 2 µM.
Neuroepithelium induction medium: 500 mL DMEM/F12 + 5 mL N2 + 5 mL Glutamax + 5 mL MEM‑NEAA + Heparin 1 µg/mL + SB431542 10 µM + LDN193189 200 nM.

steps.title: Generate vessel organoid aggregates (Day 0)
steps.instruction: Wash H9‑EGFP colonies with 1× DPBS, add 1 mL Accutase per well, incubate 10 min at 37 °C (watch after 5–6 min to avoid over‑digestion), then add 2 mL mTeSR. Collect suspension, centrifuge 200 × g 2 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in mTeSR + 10 µM Y27632. Pipette 2–3 times gently, count live cells (trypan blue exclusion). Prepare 0.5 % Lipidure solution (0.25 g in 50 mL absolute ethanol). Add 20 µL Lipidure to each well of a V‑bottom 96‑well plate, incubate 10 min, aspirate, dry 5 min in biosafety cabinet. Dilute cells in fresh aggregation medium to 7,000–9,000 cells per 150 µL. Plate 150 µL per well, incubate 48 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ to form embryoid bodies (EBs).

steps.title: Mesoderm induction (Day 2)
steps.instruction: Aspirate aggregation medium without disturbing EBs, add 150 µL mesoderm induction medium to each well, culture 48 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Endothelial induction (Day 4)
steps.instruction: Replace mesoderm induction medium with 200 µL endothelial induction medium per well, culture 72 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Endothelial maturation (Days 7‑11)
steps.instruction: Replace endothelial induction medium with 150 µL endothelial maturation medium per well, culture 48 h at 37 °C. Perform half‑medium changes on days 9 and 11.

steps.title: Embed vessel organoids in Matrigel (Day 12)
steps.instruction: Prepare dimpled Parafilm: cut 5 cm × 5 cm squares, press the tip of a 200 µL pipette into the film to create a grid of dimples. Spray both sides with 75 % ethanol, UV‑sterilize >1 h, place squares in sterile 60 mm dishes. Thaw growth‑factor‑reduced Matrigel at 4 °C overnight, keep on ice. Using a disposable Pasteur pipette, transfer each organoid into a dimple, aspirate excess medium with a 10 µL tip, then drip 10 µL Matrigel onto the organoid and center it. Incubate at 37 °C >30 min to solidify. Detach solidified droplets by gently dripping expansion medium (see step 6) onto the Matrigel with a 1,000 µL tip; the droplets fall into the well of a 6‑well plate or 60 mm dish. Culture for 4 days in expansion medium (3 mL per well of a 6‑well plate or 6 mL per dish), ≤10 organoids per well. Optional: gently shake the dish daily to prevent adhesion.

steps.title: Vessel organoid maturation (Days 16‑40)
steps.instruction: On day 16 replace expansion medium with maturation medium, place plates on a shaker set to 25–30 rpm inside the CO₂ incubator. From day 16 onward perform half‑medium changes every 2–3 days. If medium becomes yellow or volume falls below 3 mL (6 mL for dishes), add fresh medium. For later stages, transfer organoids to a T25 flask if nutrient consumption is high.

steps.title: Generate brain organoid aggregates (Day 0)
steps.instruction: Detach H9 cells with Accutase as in step 7, collect, centrifuge 200 × g 2 min, resuspend in mTeSR + 10 µM Y27632, count live cells. Coat V‑bottom 96‑well plate with 20 µL Lipidure per well, incubate 10 min, aspirate, dry 5 min. Dilute cells to 7,000–9,000 cells per 150 µL aggregation medium, plate 150 µL per well, incubate 48 h at 37 °C to form EBs (use 7,000 cells per well for brain organoids).

steps.title: Ectoderm induction (Day 2)
steps.instruction: Replace aggregation medium with 150 µL ectoderm induction medium per well, culture 48 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Half‑change ectoderm medium (Day 4)
steps.instruction: Aspirate half of the ectoderm induction medium carefully, add fresh ectoderm induction medium to restore 150 µL total, culture another 48 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Neuroepithelium induction (Day 6)
steps.instruction: Replace ectoderm induction medium with 150 µL neuroepithelium induction medium per well, culture 48 h at 37 °C. Perform half‑medium changes on days 8 and 10.

steps.title: Embed neuroepithelial tissues in Matrigel (Day 12)
steps.instruction: Follow the exact procedure described in step 9, using growth‑factor‑reduced Matrigel and dimpled Parafilm. After polymerization, transfer droplets to a 6‑well plate or 60 mm dish containing expansion medium (3 mL or 6 mL respectively). Culture 4 days before maturation.

steps.title: Brain organoid maturation (Days 16‑40)
steps.instruction: On day 16 replace expansion medium with maturation medium, place cultures on a shaker at 25–30 rpm inside the CO₂ incubator. Half‑change medium every 2–3 days and add fresh medium if volume drops below 3 mL (6 mL for dishes).

steps.title: Fuse vessel and brain organoids
steps.instruction: Generate vessel organoids (steps 7‑11) and neuroepithelial tissues (steps 11‑14) separately. Prepare dimpled Parafilm as in step 9. In each dimple transfer two vessel organoids and one neuroepithelial tissue using a Pasteur pipette, aspirate excess medium, then drip 25 µL growth‑factor‑reduced Matrigel onto the three tissues. Align the neuroepithelial tissue between the two vessel organoids, adjust so all are in the same horizontal plane. Polymerize at 37 °C >40 min. Detach droplets, place them in a 6‑well plate or 60 mm dish with expansion medium (3 mL or 6 mL). Use ≤5 fused tissues per well; if more, transfer to a T25 flask with 3 mL medium. On day 16 replace expansion medium with maturation medium, move to a shaker (25–30 rpm) and half‑change medium every 2–3 days, adding fresh medium when volume falls below 3 mL (6 mL). Observe morphology and medium colour regularly.
